name: v2.25.3
body:
## What's Changed
* Naming and commentary in GitHub Actions by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2252
* Add ARM Docker image build to CI by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2253
* Remove Python 3.10 from CI test matrix by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2254
* Restore provenance/sbom to Docker image action by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2255
* `README.md`: Try Without Installing by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2256
* Tweak `uv tool run` suggestion by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2257
* `README.md`: tweak "try without installing" section by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2258
* `README.md` refinements by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2259
* Convert remaining RST files to Markdown by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2260
* `AGENTS.md` formatting by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2261
* Use `employee` sample database for transform documentation examples by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2262
* Remove LIMIT from a transform doc example by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2263
* Prepare changelog for release v2.25.3 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2264


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.25.2...v2.25.3
